description: Source code for LVDBE (Dynamic Bass Enhancement) control functions, including parameter retrieval, capability querying, filter setup, AGC, volume control, and overall control logic.

methods.name: LVDBE_GetParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current Dynamic Bass Enhancement parameters from an instance.

methods.name: LVDBE_GetCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves current capabilities of the Dynamic Bass Enhancement instance.

methods.name: LVDBE_SetFilters
methods.description: Sets filter coefficients and clears data history based on parameters.

methods.name: LVDBE_SetAGC
methods.description: Configures Automatic Gain Control (AGC) gain level, attack, and decay times.

methods.name: LVDBE_SetVolume
methods.description: Converts volume demand from dB to linear and applies it.

methods.name: LVDBE_Control
methods.description: Sets or updates the parameters of the Bass Enhancement module, including filters, AGC, and volume.
